item.title: ChatGPT Has 'Goblin' Mania in the US. In China It Will 'Catch You Steadily'
item.description: OpenAI's chatbot has some weird linguistic tics in Chinese that are driving users crazy.

item.title: Thousands of Vibe-Coded Apps Expose Corporate and Personal Data on the Open Web
item.description: Companies like Lovable, Base44, Replit, and Netlify use AI to let anyone build a web app in seconds—and in thousands of cases, spill highly sensitive data onto the public internet.

item.title: This Reggae Band Is in a Nightmare Battle Against AI Slop Remixes
item.description: When Stick Figure’s seven-year-old song shot up the charts, the band was thrilled. But its viral moment was spurred by unauthorized AI remixes.

item.title: Elon Musk’s Last-Ditch Effort to Control OpenAI: Recruit Sam Altman to Tesla
item.description: Messages between Shivon Zilis and Tesla executives reveal plans in 2017 to start a rival AI lab, potentially led by Altman or Demis Hassabis.

item.title: Anthropic Gets in Bed With SpaceX as the AI Race Turns Weird
item.description: In an unexpected turn, the two companies signed a deal for Anthropic to use computing resources from Elon Musk’s xAI.

item.title: Using AI for Just 10 Minutes Might Make You Lazy and Dumb, Study Shows
item.description: New research suggests that reliance on AI assistants can have a negative impact on people’s ability to think and problem solve.

item.title: I Am Begging AI Companies to Stop Naming Features After Human Processes
item.description: Anthropic announced “dreaming” for AI agents to sort through “memories” at its developer conference. Can we not?

item.title: Hackers Hate AI Slop Even More Than You Do
item.description: It's not just you. Scammers, hackers, and other cybercriminals are complaining about “AI shit” flooding platforms where they discuss cyberattacks and other illegal activity.

item.title: Apple Will Pay $250 Million to Settle Lawsuit Over Siri’s AI Features
item.description: If you bought an iPhone 15 or 16 in the US, you could be set to pocket up to $95 per device as part of the settlement.

item.title: Hasan Piker, Self-Described ‘Ayatollah of Woke,’ Wants AI to Die
item.description: The far-left Twitch streamer says AI is rotting our brains. He’s also addicted to Twitter and listens to at least eight podcasts.
